What guests come for

From what guests write on Google.

Toasted sandwiches

Ham and cheese, halloumi and lountza, chicken with pesto and rocket. Guests were surprised that fries come with them.

Salads and bruschetta

Guests praise the chicken salad, the Greek salad and the beetroot salad with walnuts and goat cheese.

Coffee and cake

Hot and iced coffee with carrot cake, apple cake, lemon cake or brownies.

Homemade juices

Peach, pink lemonade, apple and pomegranate, and fresh orange juice.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Shade under a tree

Guests write that the tables stand under a tree in the pedestrian zone, with sunny and shady seats depending on the weather.

Relaxed music

Several guests mention chilled music that is quiet enough to keep talking.

Art on the walls

One guest writes that the owner painted the artwork and designed the place himself.

A cafe in the old town

Grafico Cafe is in the pedestrian zone of the Paphos old town. White benches with striped cushions, wooden tables, plants and large paintings make up the terrace, under sunshades and a tree. Guests call the atmosphere bohemian and come for a coffee, breakfast or lunch.

What guests say
